title: Run only pending cases
acceptance: `run --pending --ledger <file>` executes only cases `pending` classifies as new, changed, stale or identity-mismatched
Current cases are listed as skipped-current, not as run or passed
Same exit codes and report schema as a full run
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Fixture or regression for each acceptance item; npm test; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Implemented in PR #56; CI run 43621050710 passed before merge on 2026-11-14. The initial 0.5 h agent estimate remains in Git history.
